title: KP Flink Jobs Metrics
description: Real Flink jobs only, confirmed against the actual chart config (helmcharts/knowledgebb/charts/flink+py-flink, helmcharts/learnbb/charts/flink) and live cluster pods. KP = knowledgebb (5 jobs), LP = learnbb (3 jobs), 8 total. Only Collection Certificate Generator has full business-metric detail (verified real metric names); the other 7 have the universal Flink Kafka-consumer lag metric, the one thing guaranteed real for any Flink job -- their app-level business metrics weren't guessed since this repo doesn't expose their real names.
